$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=1\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\text{d}x=1\,\text{d}u.
$$

We can now rewrite the integral in terms of $u,$ solve it, and write the final answer in terms of $x$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{4}{x+5}\,\text{d}x & =4\int \frac{1}{u}\cdot\left(1\,\text{d}u\right) \\ & =4\int \frac{1}{u}\,\text{d}u \\ & =4\operatorname{ln}⁡|u|+C \\ & =4\operatorname{ln}⁡|x+5|+C\end{aligned}
$$
